[]}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0001", "tag": "prose", "text": "Voici ce qui se passait au-dessus de la bière où était Jean Valjean.", "sha256": "Quand le corbillard se fut éloigné, quand le prêtre et l’enfant de chœur furent remontés en voiture et partis, Fauchelevent, qui ne quittait pas des yeux le fossoyeur, le vit se pencher et empoigner sa pelle, qui était enfoncée droit dans le tas de terre.", "sha256": "c83f09e7fe2ac2eb328247e12164eb2b0041950d1799a6a3165d5e07a0b9960d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0003", "tag": "prose", "text": "Alors Fauchelevent prit une résolution suprême.", "sha256": "3148e8465caa3a46e4b1be66edbcd38e71788454b859fffa7ffbd6f1e8142f0c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0004", "tag": "prose", "text": "Il se plaça entre la fosse et le fossoyeur, croisa les bras, et dit :", "sha256": "19109a6811f8a38b53ff9a5a07b0cd7e67cc529ddcb71d9dafbf3ee76465a416", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0005", "tag": "prose", "text": "— C’est moi qui paye !", "sha256": "bb2c8ee6a1d1bac7b8765cfffbf4708d8cc687e0b60df1c93502ad61f3b9616d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0006", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le fossoyeur le regarda avec étonnement, et répondit :", "sha256": "2ab0b365a5b73503a1326b845eb6ff339a24b5655c5843d45d4ca752a5fba8be", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0007", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Quoi, paysan ?", "sha256": "ea119e1153f22ebc112ab034ae0b0033c657c4b2015608fa880b148f6865686c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0008", "tag": "prose", "text": "Fauchelevent répéta :", "sha256": "181875bd50c11d1859ad86c0f061db4f361da1844f1d67a25ddb6d6955d05418", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0009", "tag": "prose", "text": "— C’est moi qui paye !", "sha256": "bb2c8ee6a1d1bac7b8765cfffbf4708d8cc687e0b60df1c93502ad61f3b9616d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0010", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Quoi ?", "sha256": "61a0fac8ae488c6bc653f1215cdda5ca31b778598be9273b7ab3b579855004d9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0011", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Le vin.", "sha256": "d8e85800f8f2b05e32a2f7030277a4e0737a20350d0acec38ebdc4c24479484f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0012", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Quel vin ?", "sha256": "a0090a8ce66b385664953cbd4cb263a6b69881d3de32130c738df9debc9f8622", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0013", "tag": "prose", "text": "— L’Argenteuil.", "sha256": "a4e459cd1416ba2e3a80b2a7ebf04fa7f3d4668e5f0e51cbff42b2acc9afef6e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0014", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Où ça l’Argenteuil ?", "sha256": "f44c5cc8198b7ca7165e71bea88939b1387b13cdf37601507bee5b17ef66a7e5", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0015", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Au Bon Coing.", "sha256": "02073fe51e5574bc9280809649469f957ce650d3bc8ff7a2900a8495842b11a3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0016", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Va-t’en au diable ! dit le fossoyeur.", "sha256": "7a291b368f5cd4b018bccc3b2bc44b77ea65f58843779ec795e6d567d44a2e02", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0017", "tag": "prose", "text": "Et il jeta une pelletée de terre sur le cercueil.", "sha256": "f6a6b35e0c1ab520d6108d4133a36c07f06ea529145f68aaf0850350bcf090eb", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0018", "tag": "prose", "text": "La bière rendit un son creux. Fauchelevent se sentit chanceler et prêt à tomber lui-même dans la fosse. Il cria, d’une voix où commençait à se mêler l’étranglement du râle :", "sha256": "8365947676135145cc594125b4917ab5cdc97bfd9f4f940bf4fda174a4b24c5d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0019", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Camarade, avant que le Bon Coing soit fermé !", "sha256": "e2dccdb5de429b8106aee166bc5f0e3675c04281516e797b23e29cb3ad3b8872", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0020", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le fossoyeur reprit de la terre dans la pelle. Fauchelevent continua :", "sha256": "854f8e57198373f9169fae39f9a6a7aa095641e13f17a04e562abee2aa6eabe0", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0021", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je paye !", "sha256": "00ab875ffc348cacd1329a77cf530e3ca47b6410e4e9932e71c2c5699632d09d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0022", "tag": "prose", "text": "Et il saisit le bras du fossoyeur.", "sha256": "0585a2d5381c4dc5e3b871b2a14bd44d2aecfa54ad9f1a42fff9f9538ed70d7e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0023", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Écoutez-moi, camarade. Je suis le fossoyeur du couvent, je viens pour vous aider. C’est une besogne qui peut se faire la nuit. Commençons donc par aller boire un coup.", "sha256": "73cb1f1ab46868921312f96d55f380b6e7dc5759f3fae495ed2787ca8ed86212", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0024", "tag": "prose", "text": "Et tout en parlant, tout en se cramponnant à cette insistance désespérée, il faisait cette réflexion lugubre : — Et quand il boirait ! se griserait-il ?", "sha256": "acbd793efa9a0b3daf08ce120cdd626e447031de3fd0d9db5315fa4c995fb886", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0025", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Provincial, dit le fossoyeur, si vous le voulez absolument, j’y consens. Nous boirons. Après l’ouvrage, jamais avant.", "sha256": "569e91c7bba6ba55c6530026980c951a2f5ec67fc918f8f21b32d932efce001e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0026", "tag": "prose", "text": "Et il donna le branle à sa pelle. Fauchelevent le retint.", "sha256": "75412804b303cc57c3127990f6b78925e3daaaed5c85b7ddd84151e00389bb06", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0027", "tag": "prose", "text": "— C’est de l’Argenteuil à six !", "sha256": "a5547a6df10f614296d89ec3d424b9b3c9b5e74c57bdfe2fc76713e299d69394", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0028", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ah çà, dit le fossoyeur, vous êtes sonneur de cloches. Din don, din don ; vous ne savez dire que ça. Allez vous faire lanlaire.", "sha256": "787c2754fdd410993c3dc65a33e0439ef30ce9f164f534bce1c08e91486d8f30", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0029", "tag": "prose", "text": "Et il lança la seconde pelletée.", "sha256": "c312e6ca533506947fe5f476dd4f5164ab810a49775716b213d671d4a7292938", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0030", "tag": "prose", "text": "Fauchelevent arrivait à ce moment où l’on ne sait plus ce qu’on dit.", "sha256": "d2265c140c6738dbf6cef8f826ddc4e8c75cf9f0a8c7dbcaab051ca8080b6f7b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u145-r0031", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Mais venez donc boire, cria-t-il, puisque c’est moi qui paye !", "sha256": "fc9bb72a1dec14411cede322d608681bd833f0ac431adb36768ca1bb111ec7e7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
